title: eval-toolkit RunResult (compact)
description: Schema for run_dir/results.json (per-row scores stripped). Produced by eval_toolkit.harness.write_run_result.

schema_version.description: Stable schema version. Bumps on breaking output changes.

config.description: Eval-time config (n_resamples, seed, scorers, slices, paired_diffs, on_scorer_error, optional leakage_report).

additionalProperties.description: Per-slice block: n, n_positive, by_scorer, paired_diffs. Scorer blocks may optionally include transferred_operating_points for validation-fit thresholds applied to this slice.

by_fold.description: Per-fold raw RunResults (populated by evaluate_folded). Empty for non-folded runs.

fold_summary.description: CV-CI summary [slice][scorer][metric] = {mean, ci_low, ci_high, n_folds}. Empty for non-folded runs.

prediction_artifacts.description: Optional references to retained prediction artifacts associated with the result.

evidence_axes.description: Optional named axes that scope aggregate evidence.

pairing_metadata.description: Optional explicit pairing metadata for paired comparisons.

aggregate_evidence.description: Optional typed aggregate status: inferential, descriptive, diagnostic, or unsupported.

threshold_policy.description: Optional threshold policy metadata naming calibration slice, score column, selector, constraints, and claim-enabled status.
